verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù Ọma nke Devid.</e> <pb/><t>Kpem ikpe, Jehova, n'ihi na mu onwem ejewo ije n'izu-okèm:</t> <t>Ọ bu kwa na Jehova ka m'tukwasiworo obi, ukwum adighi-ab͕uchapu.</t>
<t>Nwà m, Jehova, nwaputakwam;</t> <t>Nucha akurum abua na obim.</t>
<t>N'ihi na ebere-Gi di n'iru anyam;</t> <t>Ejeghariwokwam n'ezi-okwu-Gi.</t>
<t>Mu na madu efu anọkọghi;</t> <t>Mu na ndi-iru-abua adighi-abàkọ kwa.</t>
<t>Akpọwom nkpọkọta ndi nēme ihe ọjọ asì,</t> <t>Mu na ndi nēmebi iwu adighi-anọkọ kwa.</t>
<t>Agamakwo ọbu-akam abua na-emeghi-ihe-ọjọ;</t> <t>We b͕a ebe-ichu-àjà-Gi buruburu otú a, Jehova:</t>
<t>Ime ka ege nti olu ekele,</t> <t>Na ikọ akukọ bayere oké ọlu-Gi nile.</t>
<t>Jehova, ahuwom ebe-obibi nke ulo-gi n'anya,</t> <t>Ya na ọnọdu nke ebe-obibi nke ebube-Gi.</t>
<t>Achikọtala nkpuru-obim na ndi-nmehie n'otù,</t> <t>Achikọta-kwa-la ndum na ndi-ọbara n'otù:</t>
<t>Ndi nzube ọjọ di n'ka-ha,</t> <t>Aka-nri-ha juputa-kwa-ra n'iri-ngo.</t>
<t>Ma mu onwem, n'izu-okèm ka m'gēje ije:</t> <t>B͕aputam, me-kwa-ram amara.</t>
<t>Ukwum eguzowo n'ala di lari:</t> <t>Nime nkpọkọta madu nile ka m'gāgọzi Jehova.</t>
